mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 2% triggers a preemptive S&P 500 forward return correction over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate rate hikes.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 2.0 in the current month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during inflation spikes (t-test p > 0.05), or CPIAUCSL remains below 2% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment momentum as measured by PAYEMS exceeding 130,000 monthly suggests labor market strength that supports equity valuations, producing positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Over 60-day horizon, SPX 20-day forward returns are negative despite PAYEMS > 130,000 (Rank IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 90) indicates weakening aggregate demand, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: early-cycle soft landing turning into contraction
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive when INDPRO is below 90 (contradiction in regime).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous drop in both GDPC1 (consumer demand) and RSAFS (retail sales) below historical averages signals supply-side constraints, driving negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive when both GDPC1 and RSAFS are below thresholds (interaction not detected).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.25% in a month, the S&P 500 shows a negative 20-day forward return as investors anticipate higher borrowing costs.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by >0.25% in the current month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive during FEDFUNDS increases >0.25% (mechanism invalid).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 4% over the next 3 months is associated with a 60-day negative S&P 500 forward return due to higher discount rates eroding equity present value.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive when UNRATE > 4% for 3 months (mechanism invalid).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly surge in HOUST (household spending) above 600 leads to positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns as demand recovers quickly.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive when HOUST > 600 (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent weakness in both INDPRO and GDPC1 for two consecutive months indicates persistent supply-side bottlenecks, resulting in negative 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive despite sustained weakness in both proxies (no interaction detected).
